hero.titleHtml: We make good businesses impossible to ignore.
hero.lede: StoryBizz is a media visibility partner. We put founders, brands and professionals in the places where people decide who to trust, press, Google, podcasts, magazines and social feeds.

sections.label: Our story
sections.titleHtml: Why do great businesses stay invisible?
sections.lede: Every market has excellent operators nobody has heard of, and average ones everyone has. The difference is rarely the product; it is public proof. We built StoryBizz to close that gap: one partner for press, podcasts, magazines, awards and the new frontier of AI visibility.

items.lbl: Brands, founders and professionals made visible
Campaigns delivered across media and platforms

items.title: Real outlets only
items.text: Every placement is verifiable, a link you can send to anyone.

items.title: Transparent process
items.text: You know what is being pitched, where, and how it is labelled, before you commit.

items.title: Strategy before spend
items.text: We map the right mix for your goals instead of selling a package.

items.title: You approve everything
items.text: No story goes out without your sign-off.

items.title: Built to compound
items.text: Every placement keeps working, ranking, cited, reusable.

items.title: Partner, not vendor
items.text: One team across all channels, accountable for the outcome.

items.name: Rohit S.
items.quote: Within two months, searching my name showed a Forbes feature, a podcast and three articles. Prospects come to calls already convinced.

items.name: Shreya D.

items.name: Meera J.
